description: Council will consider amending land use for 2950 Lorne Avenue.
City will sell 11.5 acres at 134 English Crescent.
New rugby fields for North Saskatchewan Rugby Union.
Administration will report options to offset sold Municipal Reserve.

chips.text: Sale price is $7,762,500 for 134 English Crescent land.
Hamm Construction (Cross Developments Inc.) will purchase the land.

chips.text: Costs shared with owner of 1818 Central Avenue, including legal fees.
